D: A miserly money lender is visited by three spirits on Christmas Eve, with a few Muppets along for the ride.
P: Serve the mains when Scrooge sends for the prize turkey.
S: Thick white bread with sharp cheddar and sweet brown pickle, cut into little party triangles.
Ghost of Christmas Present's feast board
the spirit surrounded by a mountain of food
Roast chestnuts, clementines, grapes, a wedge of Stilton, walnuts and gingerbread piled high on a big board, like the spirit's table.
the rat who can't stop thinking about food
Mature cheddar and Red Leicester cut into wedges, with pickled onions, apple chutney and oatcakes, laid out on a little wooden board.
M: the one in the shop window, bought for the Cratchits
Turkey dry-brined 48 hours, butter and thyme under the skin, roasted at 170C until the breast hits 65C, rested an hour. Chestnut stuffing, roast potatoes and gravy.
the small family dinner that feels like a feast
Goose legs salted overnight, roasted at 170C for 2 hours until crisp, potatoes roasted in the goose fat, with braised red cabbage and apple sauce.
W: Dried fruit soaked overnight in brandy, mixed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour and mixed spice, steamed 4 hours, warmed, flamed with brandy at the table. Brandy custard.
K: the hot punch Scrooge promises Bob at the end
Port and red wine warmed gently with roasted oranges studded with cloves, cinnamon and sugar, never boiled, ladled into cups.

s.how: Butter 12 slices of white bread. Spread 6 with brown pickle, cover with 250g thinly sliced aged cheddar and top with the other slices. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 triangles.

s.note: the rat who can't stop thinking about food
s.how: Take 200g vintage cheddar and 200g Red Leicester out of the fridge an hour ahead. Cut into wedges and arrange on a wooden board with pickled onions, a bowl of apple chutney and a stack of oatcakes.

m.note: the small family dinner that feels like a feast
m.how: Salt 4 goose legs overnight. Roast at 170C for 2 hours until crisp, pouring off the fat. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in that fat at 200C for 45 minutes. Braise half a red cabbage with 2 sliced apples and 3 tbsp red wine vinegar for an hour.

w.how: Soak 500g dried fruit in 100ml brandy overnight. Mix with 125g soft butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 100g breadcrumbs, 75g flour and 2 tsp mixed spice. Steam in a greased basin for 4 hours. Warm 2 tbsp brandy, light it and pour over at the table. Serve with custard.

d.note: the hot punch Scrooge promises Bob at the end
d.how: Stud 2 oranges with cloves and roast at 180C for 30 minutes. Warm 375ml port and 375ml red wine gently with the oranges, 2 cinnamon sticks and 2 tbsp sugar for 20 minutes, never boiling. Ladle into four cups.
